diego: quick a11y flag on the Dataset Upload modal in the console. When you open the modal and hit Esc to dismiss, focus doesn't return to the Upload button — it goes to the page top. Also VoiceOver reads the modal as "dialog" but doesn't announce the file input label consistently. anya: omg good catch. repro steps? diego: repro minimal: ``` 1) Console > Data > Datasets 2) Tab to "Upload dataset" button and press Enter 3) Modal opens; hit Esc to close 4) Focus lands on document body instead of the Upload button ``` mira: likely missing focus restoration in our modal layer. We used a generic portal and call close() without returning focusRef.focus(). Also check aria-modal=true and aria-labelledby usage. kevin: snippet from current modal markup: ```html

Upload dataset

``` No focus return logic in there. anya: for screen readers, ensure the file input has a visible label and aria-describedby for accepted formats. VoiceOver sometimes focuses the explicit label but if label is visually hidden we need to make sure it's accessible. mira: fix plan: (1) capture trigger element before opening, (2) on close call trigger.focus({preventScroll:true}), (3) ensure the dialog element has aria-labelledby referencing the h2, and aria-describedby referencing a short helper paragraph that lists accepted types. kevin: also add focus-trap so tab/shift+tab don't leak behind the modal. We're using our lightweight trap which didn't account for nested portals. Might need to use the centralized focus-manager util. diego: one extra nit: keyboard users can't reach the "Remove" small-icon button for uploaded files because it has only an onclick handler and tabindex=-1. Need role=button and tabindex=0. anya: agreed. Button should be semantic. Also change the small svg-only button to include aria-label="Remove file" and visible focus styles (not just outline:none). kevin: propose CSS tweak for focus ring: ```css .modal .icon-btn:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,10,10,0.1); } ``` Dark mode variant to invert colors. mira: test plan: add unit test to modal util that ensures focus is restored and add a puppeteer e2e that opens modal, tabs, hits Esc, and asserts activeElement is the original trigger. Also add a small screen-reader QA step for VoiceOver and NVDA in the issue checklist. diego: I'll file an issue and a small patch. tagging as P1 for accessibility. kevin: small accessibility enhancement: when a file is attached show live-region text like "File received: customers.csv (2 MB)" with aria-live=polite. That helps SR + keyboard users. anya: good idea. Keep messages short and polite. mira: I'll whip up the PR with focus-manager + aria labels. Can we land as a patch for 1.18.x? looks low-risk. diego: created https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4492 with repro, screenshots, VoiceOver notes, and suggested patch. a11y-bot: reminder: add to release notes under "accessibility fixes" and add checklist items: focus-restore unit test, e2e, VoiceOver/NVDA manual QA. kevin: thanks all. I'll review the PR once Mira opens it. :thumbsup: anya: I'll QA the icon buttons on macOS VoiceOver after the canary. mira: will ping here when the branch is up for review. diego: that should do it for now. cheers!
